160	    if pos <= 0:
161	        raise _line_error(
162	            source, number, f"POS {pos_text!r} is not a positive integer"
163	        )
164	    return pos
165	
166	
167	def _parse_record_line(
168	    line: str, number: int, source: str, samples: Sequence[str]
169	) -> VcfRecord:
170	    fields = line.split("\t")
171	    if len(fields) < _MIN_COLUMNS:
172	        raise _line_error(
173	            source,
174	            number,
175	            f"expected at least 8 tab-separated columns, got {len(fields)}",
176	        )
177	    if samples:
178	        expected = _MIN_COLUMNS + 1 + len(samples)
179	        if len(fields) != expected:
180	            raise _line_error(
181	                source,
182	                number,
183	                f"expected {expected} columns to match the #CHROM header, got {len(fields)}",
184	            )
185	        format_text = fields[8]
186	        if not format_text:
187	            raise _line_error(source, number, "empty FORMAT column")
188	        sample_text = tuple(fields[9:])
189	    else:
190	        if len(fields) != _MIN_COLUMNS:
191	            raise _line_error(
192	                source,
193	                number,
194	                f"expected 8 columns to match the sample-less #CHROM header, "
195	                f"got {len(fields)}",
196	            )
197	        format_text = None
198	        sample_text = ()
199	
200	    chrom, pos_text, ident, ref_text, alt_text, qual, flt, info = fields[:8]
201	
202	    if not chrom:
203	        raise _line_error(source, number, "empty CHROM column")
204	    pos = _parse_pos(pos_text, source, number)
205	
206	    if not ref_text:
207	        raise _line_error(source, number, "empty REF allele")
208	    try:
209	        ref = _validate_allele(ref_text)
210	    except ValueError as exc:
211	        raise _line_error(source, number, str(exc)) from None
212	
213	    if not alt_text:
214	        raise _line_error(source, number, "empty ALT column")
215	    alts: list[str] = []
216	    for allele in alt_text.split(","):
217	        if allele == "":
218	            raise _line_error(source, number, "empty ALT allele")
219	        if not _is_plain_allele(allele):
220	            alts.append(allele)
221	            continue
222	        try:
223	            alts.append(_validate_allele(allele))
224	        except ValueError as exc:
225	            raise _line_error(source, number, str(exc)) from None
226	
227	    return VcfRecord(
228	        chrom=chrom,
229	        pos=pos,
230	        id=ident,
231	        ref=ref,
232	        alt=tuple(alts),
233	        qual=qual,
234	        filter=flt,
235	        info=info,
236	        format_text=format_text,
237	        sample_text=sample_text,
238	        line_number=number,
239	    )
240	
241	
242	def _parse_header_line(
243	    line: str, number: int, source: str
244	) -> tuple[str, ...]:
245	    """Validate the ``#CHROM`` line and return its sample names."""
246	    columns = line.split("\t")
247	    if tuple(columns[:8]) != _FIXED_COLUMNS:
248	        raise _line_error(
249	            source,
250	            number,
251	            "the first eight #CHROM header columns must be exactly "
252	            "#CHROM\\tPOS\\tID\\tREF\\tALT\\tQUAL\\tFILTER\\tINFO",
253	        )
254	    tail = columns[8:]
255	    if not tail:
256	        return ()
257	    if tail[0] != "FORMAT":
258	        raise _line_error(
259	            source, number, "the ninth column, when present, must be FORMAT"
260	        )
261	    samples = tuple(tail[1:])
262	    if not samples:
263	        raise _line_error(source, number, "FORMAT column requires at least one sample")
264	    if any(not sample for sample in samples):
265	        raise _line_error(source, number, "empty sample name in #CHROM header")
266	    return samples
267	
268	
269	def read_vcf(
270	    source: "str | os.PathLike[str] | io.TextIOBase",
271	) -> VcfFile:
272	    """Read and validate a whole VCF document from *source*.
273	
274	    *source* is either a filesystem path (``str`` or :class:`os.PathLike`)
275	    or an already-open text stream.  ``##`` meta-information lines are
276	    kept verbatim and in order; exactly one legal ``#CHROM`` line is
277	    required and every data row must match its columns.  Records are
278	    returned in input order.
279	
280	    Raises :class:`VcfFormatError` for malformed input and :class:`OSError`
281	    when opening a path fails.
282	    """
283	    if isinstance(source, io.IOBase):
284	        stream: io.TextIOBase = source
285	        source_name = getattr(stream, "name", None)
286	        if not isinstance(source_name, str) or not source_name:
287	            source_name = "<stream>"
288	        close = False
289	    elif isinstance(source, (str, os.PathLike)):
290	        path = os.fspath(source)
291	        stream = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
292	        source_name = path
293	        close = True
294	    else:
295	        raise TypeError("source must be a text path or a text stream")
296	
297	    try:
298	        meta_lines: list[str] = []
299	        samples: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
300	        records: list[VcfRecord] = []
301	
302	        for number, raw_line in enumerate(stream, start=1):
303	            line = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
304	            if line.startswith("##"):
305	                if samples is not None:
306	                    raise _line_error(
307	                        source_name,
308	                        number,
309	                        "meta-information line after the #CHROM header",
310	                    )
311	                meta_lines.append(line)
312	            elif line.startswith("#"):
313	                if samples is not None:
314	                    raise _line_error(
315	                        source_name, number, "duplicate #CHROM column header"
316	                    )
317	                samples = _parse_header_line(line, number, source_name)
318	            else:
319	                if samples is None:
320	                    raise _line_error(
321	                        source_name, number, "data row before the #CHROM column header"
322	                    )
323	                records.append(
324	                    _parse_record_line(line, number, source_name, samples)
325	                )
326	
327	        if samples is None:
328	            raise VcfFormatError(
329	                f"{source_name}:1: missing #CHROM column header"
330	            )
331	        return VcfFile(
332	            VcfHeader(tuple(meta_lines), samples), tuple(records), source_name
333	        )
334	    finally:
335	        if close:
336	            stream.close()
337	
338	
339	def _build_reference(
340	    reference: Iterable[SequenceRecord],
341	) -> tuple[dict[str, str], set[str]]:
342	    """Map CHROM to sequence, tracking identifiers appearing more than once."""
343	    sequences: dict[str, str] = {}
344	    duplicates: set[str] = set()
345	    for record in reference:
346	        if record.identifier in sequences:
347	            duplicates.add(record.identifier)
348	        else:
349	            sequences[record.identifier] = record.sequence
350	    return sequences, duplicates
351	
352	
353	def _record_error(source: str, record: VcfRecord, message: str) -> VcfFormatError:
354	    if source and record.line_number:
355	        return VcfFormatError(f"{source}:{record.line_number}: {message}")
356	    if record.line_number:
357	        return VcfFormatError(f"line {record.line_number}: {message}")
358	    return VcfFormatError(message)
359	
360	
361	def _resolve_chromosome(
362	    record: VcfRecord,
363	    sequences: Mapping[str, str],
364	    duplicates: set[str],
365	) -> str:
366	    if record.chrom in duplicates:
367	        raise ReferenceMismatchError(
368	            f"CHROM {record.chrom} POS {record.pos}: CHROM occurs more than once "
369	            "in the reference"
370	        )
371	    try:
372	        return sequences[record.chrom]
373	    except KeyError:
374	        raise ReferenceMismatchError(
375	            f"CHROM {record.chrom} POS {record.pos}: no matching record in the reference"
376	        ) from None
377	
378	
379	def _minimize(
380	    pos: int, ref: str, alts: Sequence[str]
381	) -> tuple[int, str, tuple[str, ...]]:
382	    """Remove the common suffix and prefix shared by all alleles.
383	
384	    At least one base is always retained per allele and *pos* (1-based)
385	    is advanced by the number of stripped leading bases.
386	    """
387	    # Common suffix: compare each ALT against REF up to the shorter
388	    # length, always leaving at least one base per allele.
389	    suffix = 0
390	    while True:
391	        index = len(ref) - 1 - suffix
392	        if index <= 0:
393	            break
394	        ref_base = ref[index]
395	        ok = True
396	        for alt in alts:
397	            alt_index = len(alt) - 1 - suffix
398	            if alt_index <= 0 or alt[alt_index] != ref_base:
399	                ok = False
400	                break
401	        if not ok:
402	            break
403	        suffix += 1
404	    if suffix:
405	        ref = ref[: len(ref) - suffix]
406	        alts = tuple(alt[: len(alt) - suffix] for alt in alts)
407	
408	    # Common prefix: at least one base must remain in every allele.
409	    prefix = 0
410	    shortest = min(len(ref), min(len(alt) for alt in alts))
411	    while prefix < shortest - 1 and all(
412	        alt[prefix] == ref[prefix] for alt in alts
413	    ):
414	        prefix += 1
415	    if prefix:
416	        ref = ref[prefix:]
417	        alts = tuple(alt[prefix:] for alt in alts)
418	        pos += prefix
419	
420	    return pos, ref, tuple(alts)
421	
422	
423	def _lengths_differ(ref: str, alts: Sequence[str]) -> bool:
424	    return any(len(alt) != len(ref) for alt in alts)
425	
426	
427	def _normalize_against(
428	    record: VcfRecord,
429	    sequences: Mapping[str, str],
430	    duplicates: set[str],
431	    source: str,
432	) -> VcfRecord:
433	    chromosome = _resolve_chromosome(record, sequences, duplicates)
434	
435	    end = record.pos - 1 + len(record.ref)
436	    if record.pos < 1 or end > len(chromosome):
437	        raise _record_error(
438	            source,
439	            record,
440	            f"CHROM {record.chrom} POS {record.pos}: REF of length {len(record.ref)} "
441	            f"is out of bounds for a reference of length {len(chromosome)}",
442	        )
443	
444	    expected = chromosome[record.pos - 1 : end].upper()
445	    if expected != record.ref:
446	        raise ReferenceMismatchError(
447	            f"CHROM {record.chrom} POS {record.pos}: REF does not match the "
448	            f"reference: expected {expected!r}, found {record.ref!r}"
449	        )
450	
451	    if not all(_is_plain_allele(allele) for allele in record.alt):
452	        # Symbolic, break-end, spanning or missing ALT: verify only.
453	        return record
454	
455	    pos, ref, alts = _minimize(record.pos, record.ref, record.alt)
456	
457	    # Left-align: prepend the preceding reference base to every allele
458	    # and re-minimize.  A move only happens when re-minimization removes
459	    # a (different) right-hand base, i.e. the extended window represents
460	    # the same haplotypes; once a step leaves the alleles unchanged the
461	    # minimum POS has been reached.
462	    while pos > 1 and _lengths_differ(ref, alts):
463	        preceding = chromosome[pos - 2].upper()
464	        next_pos, next_ref, next_alts = _minimize(
465	            pos - 1,
466	            preceding + ref,
467	            tuple(preceding + alt for alt in alts),
468	        )
469	        if (next_pos, next_ref, next_alts) == (pos, ref, alts):
470	            break
471	        pos, ref, alts = next_pos, next_ref, next_alts
472	
473	    return replace(record, pos=pos, ref=ref, alt=alts)
474	
475	
476	def normalize_record(
477	    record: VcfRecord,
478	    reference: "Mapping[str, str] | Iterable[SequenceRecord]",
479	) -> VcfRecord:
480	    """Normalize one record against *reference*.
481	
482	    *reference* is either a mapping of CHROM to upper-case reference
483	    sequence or an iterable of :class:`~genome_variant.sequence_io.SequenceRecord`
484	    (duplicate identifiers raise :class:`ReferenceMismatchError`).
485	
486	    The REF fragment at POS is always verified.  Records whose ALT
487	    contains a symbolic, break-end, spanning (``*``) or missing (``.``)
488	    allele are returned unchanged.  Otherwise all sequence alleles are
489	    trimmed of their shared suffix and prefix (one base is always kept)
490	    and, when allele lengths differ, left-shifted across repeated
491	    reference bases to the smallest POS representing the same
492	    haplotypes, re-minimizing after every shift.  ID, QUAL, FILTER,
493	    INFO, FORMAT, sample text and ALT order are preserved.
494	
495	    Raises :class:`ReferenceMismatchError` for an absent/duplicate CHROM
496	    or a REF that disagrees with the reference, and
497	    :class:`VcfFormatError` for a record that runs past the reference.
498	    """
499	    if isinstance(reference, Mapping):
500	        sequences = dict(reference)
501	        duplicates: set[str] = set()
502	    else:
503	        sequences, duplicates = _build_reference(reference)
504	    return _normalize_against(record, sequences, duplicates, "")
505	
506	
507	def normalize_vcf(
508	    document: VcfFile,
509	    reference: "Mapping[str, str] | Iterable[SequenceRecord]",
510	) -> VcfFile:
511	    """Normalize every record of *document* against *reference*.
512	
513	    Record order is preserved; see :func:`normalize_record` for the
514	    per-record rules.  Every record is validated before the normalized
515	    document is returned, so an error never comes with partial output.
516	    """
517	    if isinstance(reference, Mapping):
518	        sequences = dict(reference)
519	        duplicates: set[str] = set()
520	    else:
521	        sequences, duplicates = _build_reference(reference)
522	
523	    normalized = tuple(
524	        _normalize_against(record, sequences, duplicates, document.source)
525	        for record in document.records
526	    )
527	    return VcfFile(document.header, normalized, document.source)
528	
529	
530	def _record_line(record: VcfRecord) -> str:
531	    fields = [
532	        record.chrom,
533	        str(record.pos),
534	        record.id,
535	        record.ref,
536	        record.alt_text,
537	        record.qual,
538	        record.filter,
539	        record.info,
540	    ]
541	    if record.format_text is not None:
542	        fields.append(record.format_text)
543	        fields.extend(record.sample_text)
544	    return "\t".join(fields)
545	
546	
547	def render_vcf(document: VcfFile) -> str:
548	    """Serialize *document* to VCF text.
549	
550	    Output uses tabs and ``"\\n"`` line endings and always ends with
551	    exactly one trailing newline; a record-less VCF still writes the
552	    complete header (``##`` lines followed by the ``#CHROM`` line).
553	    """
554	    lines = list(document.header.meta_lines)
555	    lines.append("\t".join(document.header.column_names))
556	    lines.extend(_record_line(record) for record in document.records)
557	    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
558	
559	
560	def write_vcf(
561	    document: VcfFile,
562	    output: "str | os.PathLike[str] | io.TextIOBase",
563	) -> None:
564	    """Write *document* to *output* as VCF text.
565	
566	    Tabs and ``"\\n"`` are used throughout with exactly one trailing
567	    newline; an empty-record VCF still writes the complete header.
568	    """
569	    text = render_vcf(document)
570	    if isinstance(output, io.IOBase):
571	        output.write(text)
572	    elif isinstance(output, (str, os.PathLike)):
573	        with open(os.fspath(output), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as stream:
574	            stream.write(text)
575	    else:
576	        raise TypeError("output must be a text path or a text stream")

1	"""FASTA/FASTQ reading and normalization.
2	
3	Public API:
4	
5	- :class:`SequenceRecord` — one sequence with identifier, description and
6	  optional per-base quality values.
7	- :func:`read_sequences` — lazily read records from a text path or text
8	  stream; the format is ``"fasta"``, ``"fastq"`` or ``"auto"``.
9	- :func:`write_sequences` — write records in FASTA or FASTQ form.
10	
11	Sequences only contain the IUPAC DNA symbols ``ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN``.  FASTQ
12	quality values use the Phred+33 encoding with ASCII characters 33–126.
13	"""
14	
15	from __future__ import annotations
16	
17	import io
18	import os
19	from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
20	from dataclasses import dataclass
21	
22	__all__ = [
23	    "SequenceRecord",
24	    "SequenceFormatError",
25	    "SequenceValidationError",
26	    "read_sequences",
27	    "write_sequences",
28	]
29	
30	_VALID_BASES = frozenset("ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN")
31	_INPUT_FORMATS = ("fasta", "fastq", "auto")
32	_OUTPUT_FORMATS = ("fasta", "fastq")
33	
34	
35	class SequenceFormatError(ValueError):
36	    """Malformed FASTA/FASTQ input (structure, identifiers, lengths)."""
37	
38	
39	class SequenceValidationError(ValueError):
40	    """A sequence contains a symbol outside the allowed IUPAC set."""
41	
42	
43	@dataclass(frozen=True)
44	class SequenceRecord:
45	    """A single sequence record.
46	
47	    ``identifier`` is the first whitespace-delimited field of the title
48	    line; ``description`` holds the remainder (``""`` when absent).
49	    ``quality`` is ``None`` for FASTA records and a tuple of Phred scores
50	    for FASTQ records.
51	    """
52	
53	    identifier: str
54	    sequence: str
55	    description: str = ""
56	    quality: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
57	
58	
59	def _clean_sequence(raw: str) -> str:
60	    """Strip in-line whitespace and upper-case a raw sequence fragment."""
61	    return "".join(raw.split()).upper()
62	
63	
64	def _validate_sequence(identifier: str, sequence: str) -> None:
65	    for position, symbol in enumerate(sequence, start=1):
66	        if symbol not in _VALID_BASES:
67	            raise SequenceValidationError(
68	                f"record {identifier!r}: invalid symbol {symbol!r} at position {position}"
69	            )
70	
71	
72	def _split_title(title: str, source: str, line_number: int) -> tuple[str, str]:
73	    fields = title.split(None, 1)
74	    if not fields:
75	        raise SequenceFormatError(f"{source}:{line_number}: empty sequence identifier")
76	    identifier = fields[0]
77	    description = fields[1] if len(fields) == 2 else ""
78	    return identifier, description
79	
80	
81	def _line_error(source: str, line_number: int, message: str) -> SequenceFormatError:
82	    return SequenceFormatError(f"{source}:{line_number}: {message}")
83	
84	
85	def _fasta_records(
86	    lines: Iterator[tuple[int, str]], source: str
87	) -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
88	    header_line: str | None = None
89	    header_number = 0
90	    seq_parts: list[str] = []
91	
92	    for number, raw_line in lines:
93	        line = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
94	        if line.startswith(">"):
95	            if header_line is not None:
96	                yield _finish_fasta(header_line, header_number, seq_parts, source)
97	            header_line = line
98	            header_number = number
99	            seq_parts = []
100	        elif line.strip():
101	            if header_line is None:
102	                raise _line_error(
103	                    source,
104	                    number,
105	                    "content before first title line (expected a line starting with '>')",
106	                )
107	            seq_parts.append(line)
108	        # Blank lines outside or inside a record are ignored.
109	
110	    if header_line is not None:
111	        yield _finish_fasta(header_line, header_number, seq_parts, source)
112	
113	
114	def _finish_fasta(
115	    header_line: str, header_number: int, parts: list[str], source: str
116	) -> SequenceRecord:
117	    identifier, description = _split_title(header_line[1:], source, header_number)
118	    sequence = _clean_sequence("".join(parts))
119	    if not sequence:
120	        raise _line_error(source, header_number, "empty sequence")
121	    _validate_sequence(identifier, sequence)
122	    return SequenceRecord(identifier, sequence, description)
123	
124	
125	def _check_quality_segment(segment: str, source: str, line_number: int) -> None:
126	    for char in segment:
127	        value = ord(char)
128	        if value < 33 or value > 126:
129	            raise _line_error(
130	                source,
131	                line_number,
132	                f"quality character {char!r} is outside the ASCII 33-126 range",
133	            )
134	
135	
136	def _fastq_records(
137	    lines: Iterator[tuple[int, str]], source: str
138	) -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
139	    # State machine over logical lines.  Sequence and quality may each
140	    # span several physical lines; record boundaries are determined by the
141	    # '+' separator and the number of quality characters matching the
142	    # sequence length.
143	    header_line: str | None = None
144	    header_number = 0
145	    seq_parts: list[str] = []
146	    qual_segments: list[str] = []
147	    in_quality = False
148	
149	    for number, raw_line in lines:
150	        line = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
151	
152	        if header_line is None:
153	            if not line:
154	                raise _line_error(
155	                    source,
156	                    number,
157	                    "incomplete FASTQ record (expected a title line starting with '@')",
158	                )
159	            if not line.startswith("@"):
160	                raise _line_error(
161	                    source, number, "expected a FASTQ title line starting with '@'"
162	                )
163	            header_line = line
164	            header_number = number
165	            seq_parts = []
166	            qual_segments = []
167	            in_quality = False
168	            continue
169	
170	        if not in_quality:
171	            if line.startswith("+"):
172	                plus_title = line[1:]
173	                if plus_title and plus_title != header_line[1:]:
174	                    raise _line_error(
175	                        source,
176	                        number,
177	                        "FASTQ separator title does not match the record title",
178	                    )
179	                if not _clean_sequence("".join(seq_parts)):
180	                    raise _line_error(source, header_number, "empty sequence")
181	                in_quality = True
182	            else:
183	                if not line.strip():
184	                    raise _line_error(source, number, "empty sequence")
185	                seq_parts.append(line)
186	            continue
187	
188	        if not line:
189	            raise _line_error(source, number, "incomplete FASTQ record (missing quality values)")
190	        _check_quality_segment(line, source, number)
191	        qual_segments.append(line)
192	
193	        sequence = _clean_sequence("".join(seq_parts))
194	        quality_text = "".join(qual_segments)
195	        if len(quality_text) > len(sequence):
196	            raise _line_error(
197	                source,
198	                number,
199	                f"quality length {len(quality_text)} does not match sequence length {len(sequence)}",
200	            )
201	        if len(quality_text) == len(sequence):
202	            yield _finish_fastq(
203	                header_line, header_number, sequence, quality_text, source
204	            )
205	            header_line = None
206	
207	    if header_line is not None:
208	        raise _line_error(source, header_number, "incomplete FASTQ record")
209	
210	
211	def _finish_fastq(
212	    header_line: str,
213	    header_number: int,
214	    sequence: str,
215	    quality_text: str,
216	    source: str,
217	) -> SequenceRecord:
218	    identifier, description = _split_title(header_line[1:], source, header_number)
219	    if not sequence:
220	        raise _line_error(source, header_number, "empty sequence")
221	    _validate_sequence(identifier, sequence)
222	    if len(quality_text) != len(sequence):
223	        raise _line_error(
224	            source,
225	            header_number,
226	            f"quality length {len(quality_text)} does not match sequence length {len(sequence)}",
227	        )
228	    quality = tuple(ord(char) - 33 for char in quality_text)
229	    return SequenceRecord(identifier, sequence, description, quality)
230	
231	
232	def _enumerate_lines(stream: Iterable[str]) -> Iterator[tuple[int, str]]:
233	    for number, line in enumerate(stream, start=1):
234	        yield number, line
235	
236	
237	def read_sequences(
238	    source: "str | os.PathLike[str] | io.TextIOBase",
239	    format: str = "auto",
240	) -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
241	    """Lazily read sequence records from *source*.
242	
243	    *source* is either a filesystem path (``str`` or :class:`os.PathLike`)
244	    or an already-open text stream.  *format* is ``"fasta"``, ``"fastq"``
245	    or ``"auto"``; with ``"auto"`` the format is detected from the first
246	    non-empty line (``>`` → FASTA, ``@`` → FASTQ).
247	
248	    Records are produced in input order.  Errors raised while opening a
249	    path propagate as :class:`OSError`; malformed input raises
250	    :class:`SequenceFormatError` or :class:`SequenceValidationError`
251	    during iteration and are never swallowed.
252	    """
253	    if format not in _INPUT_FORMATS:
254	        raise ValueError(
255	            f"unsupported format {format!r}; expected one of {', '.join(_INPUT_FORMATS)}"
256	        )
257	
258	    if isinstance(source, io.IOBase):
259	        stream: io.TextIOBase = source
260	        source_name = getattr(stream, "name", None)
261	        if not isinstance(source_name, str) or not source_name:
262	            source_name = "<stream>"
263	        close = False
264	    elif isinstance(source, (str, os.PathLike)):
265	        path = os.fspath(source)
266	        stream = open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
267	        source_name = path
268	        close = True
269	    else:
270	        raise TypeError("source must be a text path or a text stream")
271	
272	    try:
273	        yield from _read_from_stream(stream, source_name, format)
274	    finally:
275	        if close:
276	            stream.close()
277	
278	
279	def _read_from_stream(
280	    stream: Iterable[str], source_name: str, format: str
281	) -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
282	    numbered = _enumerate_lines(stream)
283	
284	    first_number = 0
285	    first_line: str | None = None
286	    for number, raw_line in numbered:
287	        candidate = raw_line.rstrip("\r\n")
288	        if candidate.strip():
289	            first_number = number
290	            first_line = candidate
291	            break
292	
293	    if first_line is None:
294	        if format == "auto":
295	            raise SequenceFormatError(
296	                f"{source_name}: empty input; cannot determine format"
297	            )
298	        raise SequenceFormatError(f"{source_name}: empty input")
299	
300	    if format == "auto":
301	        if first_line.startswith(">"):
302	            detected = "fasta"
303	        elif first_line.startswith("@"):
304	            detected = "fastq"
305	        else:
306	            raise _line_error(
307	                source_name,
308	                first_number,
309	                "cannot determine format: first non-empty line must start with '>' or '@'",
310	            )
311	    else:
312	        detected = format
313	
314	    def replay() -> Iterator[tuple[int, str]]:
315	        yield first_number, first_line + "\n"
316	        yield from numbered
317	
318	    # The per-format parsers reject a first line that lacks their title
319	    # marker themselves (reported as content before / unexpected title).
320	    if detected == "fasta":
321	        yield from _fasta_records(replay(), source_name)
322	    else:
323	        yield from _fastq_records(replay(), source_name)
324	
325	
326	def write_sequences(
327	    records: Iterable[SequenceRecord],
328	    output: "str | os.PathLike[str] | io.TextIOBase",
329	    format: str = "fasta",
330	    line_width: int = 60,
331	) -> None:
332	    """Write *records* to *output* in FASTA or FASTQ form.
333	
334	    FASTA sequences are wrapped at *line_width* characters (a positive
335	    integer); FASTQ always uses the fixed four-line layout regardless of
336	    *line_width*.  Records without quality values cannot be written as
337	    FASTQ.  Output uses ``"\\n"`` line endings and ends with exactly one
338	    trailing newline.
339	    """
340	    if format not in _OUTPUT_FORMATS:
341	        raise ValueError(f"unsupported format {format!r}; expected 'fasta' or 'fastq'")
342	    if not isinstance(line_width, int) or isinstance(line_width, bool) or line_width <= 0:
343	        raise ValueError("line_width must be a positive integer")
344	
345	    if isinstance(output, io.IOBase):
346	        stream: io.TextIOBase = output
347	        close = False
348	    elif isinstance(output, (str, os.PathLike)):
349	        stream = open(os.fspath(output), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="")
350	        close = True
351	    else:
352	        raise TypeError("output must be a text path or a text stream")
353	
354	    try:
355	        for record in records:
356	            _validate_sequence(record.identifier, record.sequence)
357	            if format == "fasta":
358	                stream.write(_format_fasta_record(record, line_width))
359	            else:
360	                stream.write(_format_fastq_record(record))
361	    finally:
362	        if close:
363	            stream.close()
364	
365	
366	def _format_title(record: SequenceRecord) -> str:
367	    if record.description:
368	        return record.identifier + " " + record.description
369	    return record.identifier
370	
371	
372	def _format_fasta_record(record: SequenceRecord, line_width: int) -> str:
373	    parts = [">" + _format_title(record) + "\n"]
374	    sequence = record.sequence
375	    for start in range(0, len(sequence), line_width):
376	        parts.append(sequence[start : start + line_width])
377	        parts.append("\n")
378	    return "".join(parts)
379	
380	
381	def _format_fastq_record(record: SequenceRecord) -> str:
382	    if record.quality is None:
383	        raise ValueError(
384	            f"record {record.identifier!r} has no quality values; cannot write it as FASTQ"
385	        )
386	    if len(record.quality) != len(record.sequence):
387	        raise ValueError(
388	            f"record {record.identifier!r}: quality length does not match sequence length"
389	        )
390	    quality_chars = []
391	    for value in record.quality:
392	        if not 0 <= value <= 93:
393	            raise ValueError(
394	                f"record {record.identifier!r}: quality score {value} is outside the "
395	                "Phred+33 range 0-93"
396	            )
397	        quality_chars.append(chr(value + 33))
398	    title = _format_title(record)
399	    return f"@{title}\n{record.sequence}\n+{title}\n{''.join(quality_chars)}\n"

"""Tests for the map-reads subcommand."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys


def run(argv, stdin: str = ""):
    from io import StringIO

    old_in, old_out, old_err = sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr
    sys.stdin = StringIO(stdin)
    sys.stdout = StringIO()
    sys.stderr = StringIO()
    try:
        try:
            from genome_variant.cli import main

            code = main(argv)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            code = exc.code
    finally:
        out, err = sys.stdout.getvalue(), sys.stderr.getvalue()
        sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr = old_in, old_out, old_err
    return code, out, err


EXPECTED_KEYS = [
    "record",
    "id",
    "mapped",
    "reference_record",
    "reference",
    "reference_start",
    "reference_end",
    "query_start",
    "query_end",
    "strand",
    "score",
    "cigar",
]


def write(tmp_path, name, text):
    path = tmp_path / name
    path.write_text(text)
    return path


class TestMapReads:
    def test_basic_multi_reference_jsonl(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGTACGT\n>c2\nTTTTACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n>b\nTTTT\n")
        code, out, err = run(["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads)])
        assert code == 0
        assert err == ""
        lines = out.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) == 2
        payloads = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
        for payload in payloads:
            assert list(payload) == EXPECTED_KEYS
        assert payloads[0] == {
            "record": 0,
            "id": "a",
            "mapped": True,
            "reference_record": 0,
            "reference": "c1",
            "reference_start": 0,
            "reference_end": 4,
            "query_start": 0,
            "query_end": 4,
            "strand": "+",
            "score": 8,
            "cigar": "4=",
        }
        assert payloads[1]["reference_record"] == 1
        assert payloads[1]["id"] == "b"

    def test_fastq_reads_auto_detected_and_quality_ignored(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fq", "@a\nACGT\n+a\n!!!!\n")
        code, out, err = run(["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads)])
        assert code == 0
        payload = json.loads(out)
        assert payload["mapped"] is True
        assert payload["score"] == 8
        assert payload["cigar"] == "4="

    def test_explicit_reads_format(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.dat", "@a\nACGT\n+a\nIIII\n")
        code, out, err = run(
            ["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads), "--reads-format", "fastq"]
        )
        assert code == 0
        assert json.loads(out)["cigar"] == "4="

    def test_reads_from_stdin_while_reference_is_file(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nTTTT\n")
        code, out, err = run(
            ["map-reads", str(reference), "-"],
            ">a\nAAAA\n",
        )
        assert code == 0
        payload = json.loads(out)
        assert payload["strand"] == "-"
        assert payload["score"] == 8

    def test_reference_from_stdin_while_reads_are_file(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n")
        code, out, err = run(["map-reads", "-", str(reads)], ">c1\nACGT\n")
        assert code == 0
        assert json.loads(out)["reference"] == "c1"

    def test_unmapped_record_uses_only_record_id_mapped_false(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nTTTT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">lost\nGCGC\n")
        code, out, err = run(["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads)])
        assert code == 0
        payload = json.loads(out)
        assert payload == {
            "record": 0,
            "id": "lost",
            "mapped": False,
            "reference_record": None,
            "reference": None,
            "reference_start": None,
            "reference_end": None,
            "query_start": None,
            "query_end": None,
            "strand": None,
            "score": None,
            "cigar": None,
        }

    def test_min_score_filters(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n")
        code, out, err = run(
            ["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads), "--min-score", "9"]
        )
        assert code == 0
        assert json.loads(out)["mapped"] is False

    def test_scoring_options_accepted(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n")
        code, out, err = run(
            [
                "map-reads",
                str(reference),
                str(reads),
                "--match",
                "1",
                "--mismatch",
                "1",
                "--gap-open",
                "0",
                "--gap-extend",
                "0",
                "--min-score",
                "1",
            ]
        )
        assert code == 0
        assert json.loads(out)["score"] == 4

    def test_output_ends_with_exactly_one_newline(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n>b\nGCGC\n")
        code, out, err = run(["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads)])
        assert code == 0
        assert out.endswith("\n")
        assert not out.endswith("\n\n")
        assert out.count("\n") == 2


class TestMapReadsErrors:

        assert out == ""

class TestMapReadsOutput:
    def test_file_output_is_atomic_and_byte_stable(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        reference = write(tmp_path, "r.fa", ">c1\nACGTACGT\n>c2\nTTTT\n")
        reads = write(tmp_path, "q.fa", ">a\nACGT\n>b\nAAAA\n>c\nGCGC\n")

        second = tmp_path / "b.jsonl"
        code1, _, err1 = run(
            ["map-reads", str(reference), str(reads), "--output", str(first)]

1	"""Read quality trimming and filtering.
2	
3	Public API:
4	
5	- :class:`ReadQualityError` — a record lacks quality values, carries the
6	  wrong number of them, or holds scores outside Phred+33 range 0-93.
7	- :func:`filter_reads` — lazily trim low-quality ends and drop records by
8	  mean quality and minimum length.
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
14	
15	from .sequence_io import SequenceRecord
16	
17	__all__ = [
18	    "ReadQualityError",
19	    "filter_reads",
20	]
21	
22	_PHRED_MIN = 0
23	_PHRED_MAX = 93
24	
25	
26	class ReadQualityError(ValueError):
27	    """A record has no quality values, a quality/sequence length mismatch,
28	    or a quality score outside the Phred+33 range 0-93.
29	
30	    The message always contains the offending record's identifier.
31	    """
32	
33	
34	def _threshold(name: str, value: object, *, allow_zero: bool) -> int:
35	    if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
36	        kind = type(value).__name__
37	        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-boolean integer, not {kind}")

"""Read quality trimming and filtering.

Public API:

- :class:`ReadQualityError` — a record lacks quality values, carries the
  wrong number of them, or holds scores outside Phred+33 range 0-93.
- :func:`filter_reads` — lazily trim low-quality ends and drop records by
  mean quality and minimum length.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator

from .sequence_io import SequenceRecord

__all__ = [
    "ReadQualityError",
    "filter_reads",
]

_PHRED_MIN = 0
_PHRED_MAX = 93


class ReadQualityError(ValueError):
    """A record has no quality values, a quality/sequence length mismatch,
    or a quality score outside the Phred+33 range 0-93.

    The message always contains the offending record's identifier.
    """


def _threshold(name: str, value: object, *, allow_zero: bool) -> int:
    if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
        kind = type(value).__name__
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-boolean integer, not {kind}")
    if allow_zero:
        if not _PHRED_MIN <= value <= _PHRED_MAX:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be between {_PHRED_MIN} and {_PHRED_MAX}")
    elif value < 1:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be at least 1")
    return value


def filter_reads(
    records: Iterable[SequenceRecord],
    min_end_quality: int = 20,
    min_mean_quality: int = 20,
    min_length: int = 30,
) -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
    """Yield records after end trimming and quality/length filtering.

    Each record is processed lazily, in iteration order:

    1. Bases whose Phred score is strictly below *min_end_quality* are
       removed consecutively from both ends; bases equal to the threshold
       are kept and low-quality bases inside the read never split it.
    2. A record is dropped when every base was trimmed, when the trimmed
       length is below *min_length*, or when the mean quality (sum of
       scores divided by trimmed length) is below *min_mean_quality*.
    3. Surviving records keep their identifier and description; sequence
       and quality are sliced together.

    *min_end_quality* and *min_mean_quality* are non-boolean integers in
    the Phred range 0-93 (defaults 20 and 20); *min_length* is a
    non-boolean integer of at least 1 (default 30).  Invalid parameters
    raise :class:`ValueError`; records without quality values, with a
    quality/sequence length mismatch or with scores outside 0-93 raise
    :class:`ReadQualityError` (mentioning the record identifier) when
    that record is reached during iteration.
    """
    end_threshold = _threshold(
        "min_end_quality", min_end_quality, allow_zero=True
    )
    mean_threshold = _threshold(
        "min_mean_quality", min_mean_quality, allow_zero=True
    )
    length_threshold = _threshold("min_length", min_length, allow_zero=False)

    def _iter() -> Iterator[SequenceRecord]:
        # Record problems surface lazily, when each record is reached.
        for record in records:
            trimmed = _filter_one(
                record, end_threshold, mean_threshold, length_threshold
            )
            if trimmed is not None:
                yield trimmed

    return _iter()


def _filter_one(
    record: SequenceRecord,
    end_threshold: int,
    mean_threshold: int,
    length_threshold: int,
) -> SequenceRecord | None:
    identifier = record.identifier
    quality = record.quality
    sequence = record.sequence

    if quality is None:
        raise ReadQualityError(
            f"record {identifier!r}: has no quality values"
        )
    if len(quality) != len(sequence):
        raise ReadQualityError(
            f"record {identifier!r}: quality length {len(quality)} does not "
            f"match sequence length {len(sequence)}"
        )
    for score in quality:
        if not isinstance(score, int):
            raise ReadQualityError(
                f"record {identifier!r}: quality score {score!r} is not an integer"
            )
        if not _PHRED_MIN <= score <= _PHRED_MAX:
            raise ReadQualityError(
                f"record {identifier!r}: quality score {score} is outside the "
                "Phred+33 range 0-93"
            )

    left = 0
    right = len(quality)
    while left < right and quality[left] < end_threshold:
        left += 1
    while right > left and quality[right - 1] < end_threshold:
        right -= 1

    trimmed_length = right - left
    if trimmed_length < length_threshold:
        return None
    if sum(quality[left:right]) < mean_threshold * trimmed_length:
        return None

    return SequenceRecord(
        record.identifier,
        sequence[left:right],
        record.description,
        quality[left:right],
    )

1	## 用途
2	
3	本项目是「基因组变异分析工具链」的代码仓库，用于逐步实现该方向的序列处理、比对与变异分析能力。
4	
5	当前版本提供 FASTA/FASTQ 序列的读取、校验与规范化、读段质量过滤、k-mer 索引、成对序列比对、多参考多读段的确定性映射以及参考序列感知的 VCF 规范化功能。
6	
7	## 环境与安装
8	
9	- Python 3.11 及以上
10	
11	```bash
12	python -m pip install -e .
13	```
14	
15	## 测试
16	
17	```bash
18	python -m pytest
19	```
20	
21	## 命令行入口
22	
23	安装后提供 `genome-variant-toolkit` 命令：
24	
25	```bash
26	genome-variant-toolkit version       # 打印版本号
27	genome-variant-toolkit --help        # 打印用法（无子命令时同样打印帮助并返回 0）
28	```
29	
30	### normalize-sequences
31	
32	读取 FASTA 或 FASTQ 并输出规范化结果：
33	
34	```bash
35	genome-variant-toolkit normalize-sequences INPUT \
36	    [--input-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
37	    [--output-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
38	    [--output OUTPUT] \
39	    [--line-width N]
40	```
41	
42	- `INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时分别表示标准输入、标准输出；默认输出到标准输出，格式自动识别并保持原格式。
43	- FASTA 序列按 `--line-width`（正整数，默认 60）换行；FASTQ 始终输出每条记录四行，质量按 Phred+33 还原，`--line-width` 不影响 FASTQ 布局。
44	- 将没有质量值的 FASTA 记录写成 FASTQ 属于用法错误。
45	- 相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出，文本统一使用 `\n`，文件末尾恰有一个换行符。
46	- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数或格式错误 `2`（标准错误单行消息）；文件读写错误 `1`。
47	
48	### filter-reads
49	
50	只接受 FASTQ 输入，按质量修剪末端并过滤读段：
51	
52	```bash
53	genome-variant-toolkit filter-reads INPUT \
54	    [--min-end-quality N] \
55	    [--min-mean-quality N] \
56	    [--min-length N] \
57	    [--output OUTPUT]
58	```
59	
60	- `--min-end-quality`（默认 20）：从左右两端连续删除 Phred 分值**严格低于**该阈值的碱基；等于阈值的碱基保留，内部低质量碱基不切分读段。
61	- `--min-mean-quality`（默认 20）：修剪后质量分总和小于「阈值 × 修剪后长度」的记录被丢弃。
62	- `--min-length`（默认 30，至少 1）：修剪后长度短于该值的记录被丢弃；全部碱基被修剪同样丢弃。
63	- 质量阈值只接受 0 至 93 的非布尔整数；非法阈值、FASTA 输入、格式或碱基错误以及记录质量错误均返回 `2`（标准错误单行消息）；文件读写失败返回 `1`。
64	- `INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定，未指定 `--output` 时写标准输出；记录按输入顺序写出，四行 Phred+33 布局、`\n` 换行、文件末尾恰有一个换行符；全部记录被过滤时输出为空，成功时标准错误为空。
65	- 输出到文件时先写同目录临时文件，成功后原子替换；任一读取、校验、处理或写入错误都不会留下部分结果，已有目标内容保持不变。
66	- 相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出。
67	
68	### kmer-index
69	
70	读取 FASTA 或 FASTQ，构建 k-mer 索引并以 JSON Lines 输出：
71	
72	```bash
73	genome-variant-toolkit kmer-index INPUT --k N \
74	    [--input-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
75	    [--no-canonical] \
76	    [--output OUTPUT]
77	```
78	
79	- `--k` 为必填的正整数 k-mer 长度；`--no-canonical` 关闭正反向互补归并（默认以正向片段与其反向互补中字典序较小者为键，反向互补来源标记为 `-`，回文固定为 `+`）。
80	- 每个 k-mer 输出一行紧凑 JSON，固定包含 `kmer`、`count`、`occurrences`；位置对象固定包含 `record`（零基记录序号）、`id`、`position`（零基起点）、`strand`；行按 kmer 字典序排列，非 ASCII 标识原样保留。
81	- 含非 `A`、`C`、`G`、`T` 符号的窗口被跳过，短于 k 的记录无条目；重复标识不合并；不按质量值过滤记录。
82	- 输出统一使用 `\n`，非空结果末尾恰有一个换行符，空索引输出为空；`INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定。
83	- 输出到文件时先完成全部读取与校验，再经同目录临时文件原子替换；失败不改变已有目标、不留下部分结果。
84	- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数、格式或序列错误 `2`（标准错误单行消息，且不输出数据）；文件读写错误 `1`。
85	
86	### align-pair
87	
88	对两个各含一条记录的 FASTA/FASTQ 输入进行成对序列比对，输出单行紧凑 JSON；FASTQ 质量值不参与打分：
89	
90	```bash
91	genome-variant-toolkit align-pair REFERENCE QUERY \
92	    [--reference-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
93	    [--query-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
94	    [--mode global|local] \
95	    [--match N] [--mismatch N] [--gap-open N] [--gap-extend N] \
96	    [--output OUTPUT]
97	```
98	
99	- `REFERENCE`、`QUERY` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但两个输入不能同时为标准输入；输入格式默认自动识别，各自必须恰好包含一条记录。
100	- `--match`（别名 `--match-score`，默认 2）为正整数匹配分；`--mismatch`（别名 `--mismatch-penalty`，默认 3）、`--gap-open`（默认 5）、`--gap-extend`（默认 2）为非负整数罚分；长度为 `L` 的连续缺口扣 `gap_open + gap_extend × (L-1)`。仅完全相同的字符算匹配，其他 IUPAC 组合（如 `R` 对 `A`）均算错配。
101	- `--mode global`（默认）覆盖两条完整序列；`--mode local` 只返回正分最佳片段，无正分片段时返回 0 分、四个坐标均为 0、空 CIGAR 与空对齐串。同分时依次选择 `reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end` 较小者，仍相同则选择 CIGAR 字典序较小者。
102	- 输出按固定顺序包含 `reference`、`query`（记录标识）、`mode`、`score`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`cigar`、`aligned_reference`、`aligned_query`；坐标零基、右端不含；CIGAR 使用 `=`、`X`、`I`（只消耗查询）、`D`（只消耗参考），相邻同类操作合并；对齐串以 `-` 表示缺口。成功输出末尾恰有一个 `\n`。
103	- 输出到文件时仅在全部校验与比对成功后经同目录临时文件原子替换；失败保留已有内容且无部分结果。相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出。
104	- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数错误、空输入、多条记录、两边同时使用标准输入、格式或序列错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行，标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。
105	
106	### map-reads
107	
108	把多条 FASTA/FASTQ 读段确定性地映射到多记录 FASTA 参考上，按读段输入顺序输出 JSON Lines，每条一行；FASTQ 质量值不参与打分：
109	
110	```bash
111	genome-variant-toolkit map-reads REFERENCE READS \
112	    [--reads-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
113	    [--match N] [--mismatch N] [--gap-open N] [--gap-extend N] \
114	    [--min-score N] \
115	    [--output OUTPUT]
116	```
117	
118	- `REFERENCE` 按 FASTA 解析，可含多条参考记录；`READS` 为 FASTA 或 FASTQ，默认自动识别（可用 `--reads-format` 指定）。两者与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但两个输入不能同时为标准输入。
119	- 每条读段分别以原序列（正链）与完整 IUPAC 反向互补序列（负链），与每条参考记录做局部比对，计分参数与 `align-pair` 的局部比对一致（默认 `--match 2`、`--mismatch 3`、`--gap-open 5`、`--gap-extend 2`）；`--min-score` 为默认值 1 的非布尔正整数，只保留分数不低于该值的候选。
120	- 候选先按分数从高到低选择；同分时依次取参考输入序号、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、正链优先、换算回原读段后的 `query_start`、`query_end`、CIGAR 字典序较小者。负链的查询坐标为换算到原读段后的零基半开区间，CIGAR 仍按参考与反向互补读段的方向解释；重复标识不合并。
121	- 无达标候选的读段仍输出一条未映射记录。每行固定按顺序包含 `record`（零基读段序号）、`id`、`mapped`、`reference_record`（零基参考序号）、`reference`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`strand`（`+` 或 `-`）、`score`、`cigar`；未映射记录仅 `record`、`id` 与 `mapped:false` 有值，其余字段均为 `null`。
122	- 输出统一使用 `\n`，非空结果末尾恰有一个换行符（每条读段恰好对应一行，故成功输出不会为空）；写文件时仅在全部读段成功处理后经同目录临时文件原子替换，任一读取、校验或处理失败都保留已有目标且不留部分结果。相同输入与参数无论如何分批都产生逐字节相同的结果。
123	- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数错误、空参考/空读段输入、两边同时使用标准输入、格式或序列错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行、标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。
124	
125	### normalize-vcf
126	
127	读取 VCF 并结合必需的参考 FASTA 进行参考序列感知的规范化（等位基因最简化与左对齐）：
128	
129	```bash
130	genome-variant-toolkit normalize-vcf INPUT --reference REFERENCE \
131	    [--output OUTPUT]
132	```
133	
134	- `INPUT`、`--reference` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但 VCF 与参考不能同时使用标准输入；参考按 FASTA 解析。
135	- 读取时保留全部 `##` 元信息行的原有内容与顺序，要求恰有一条合法的 `#CHROM` 列头，记录按输入顺序产生；固定列、FORMAT 与样本列数必须与列头一致。
136	- 普通序列型 REF/ALT 统一为大写并只允许 IUPAC DNA 符号 `ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN`。
137	- 规范化时按 CHROM 在参考中查找唯一记录：先校验 POS 处的 REF 片段，再把一个记录内全部序列型等位基因作为整体移除共同的最长后缀与前缀（始终为每个等位基因保留至少一个碱基，POS 随前缀裁剪同步前移）；等位基因长度不同时继续向左移动到在参考上表示相同单倍型的最小 POS，每次移动后重新最简化。ALT 次序以及 ID、QUAL、FILTER、INFO、FORMAT 与样本文本保持不变。
138	- 含任一符号型 ALT（`<...>`）、断点 ALT（含 `[`、`]` 或 `.` 连接）、`*` 或缺失值 `.` 的记录不剪裁也不左移，但仍校验 REF；记录顺序不变。
139	- 缺少或重复 `#CHROM` 列头、列数不符、非正整数 POS、空或非法 REF/ALT、记录越界统一为 `VcfFormatError`（消息含来源与一基行号）；参考中缺少或重复 CHROM、REF 与参考不一致为 `ReferenceMismatchError`（消息含 CHROM、POS 及可判定的期望值与实际值）。
140	- 成功输出使用制表符与 `\n`，末尾恰有一个换行；无记录的 VCF 仍写出完整头部。写文件时先完成全部记录的读取与校验，再经同目录临时文件原子替换，失败保留原文件。相同输入与参考产生逐字节一致的结果。
141	- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数或格式错误、`VcfFormatError`、`ReferenceMismatchError` 以及参考 FASTA 的序列格式错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行、标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。
142	
143	## Python 公开接口
144	
145	模块 `genome_variant.sequence_io` 提供：
146	
147	- `SequenceRecord(identifier, sequence, description="", quality=None)`：记录标识、大写序列、标题余部（描述），FASTQ 记录的 `quality` 为 Phred 质量整数元组，FASTA 为 `None`。
148	- `read_sequences(source, format="auto")`：接受文本路径或文本流，`format` 为 `fasta`、`fastq` 或 `auto`，按输入顺序惰性产生记录。
149	- `write_sequences(records, output, format="fasta", line_width=60)`：写 FASTA 或 FASTQ。
150	
151	模块 `genome_variant.quality` 提供：
152	
153	- `filter_reads(records, min_end_quality=20, min_mean_quality=20, min_length=30)`：惰性的读段修剪与过滤入口，接收 `SequenceRecord` 迭代器并按输入顺序产生新记录。每条记录先从左右两端连续删除 Phred 分值严格低于末端阈值的碱基（等于阈值保留，内部低质量碱基不切分）；全部碱基被删除、修剪后长度小于最短长度、或质量分总和小于平均质量阈值乘以修剪后长度时丢弃该记录；保留记录的标识与描述不变，序列与质量同步切片。三个阈值只接受非布尔整数，质量阈值限于 0 至 93，最短长度至少为 1，非法值在调用时抛出 `ValueError`；记录错误在迭代到该记录时惰性出现。
154	
155	模块 `genome_variant.kmer` 提供：
156	
157	- `KmerOccurrence(record, id, position, strand)`：一次 k-mer 出现，含零基记录序号、记录标识、零基序列起点与方向（`+` 或 `-`）。
158	- `build_kmer_index(records, k, canonical=True)`：接收 `SequenceRecord` 可迭代对象，返回以 k-mer 为键、按键字典序排列的映射，值为按输入顺序排列的 `KmerOccurrence` 列表。`canonical` 为真时以正向片段及其反向互补中字典序较小者为键（反向互补来源标 `-`，回文固定 `+`），为假时仅索引正向片段并标 `+`；含非 `ACGT` 符号的窗口跳过，短于 k 的记录无条目，重复标识不合并。`k` 只接受至少为 1 的非布尔整数，`canonical` 只接受布尔值，非法参数在消费 `records` 前抛出 `ValueError`；记录含非法碱基时在迭代到该记录时抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。
159	
160	模块 `genome_variant.alignment` 提供：
161	
162	- `PairwiseAlignment`：不可变结果对象，字段依次为 `reference`、`query`（记录标识）、`mode`、`score`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`cigar`、`aligned_reference`、`aligned_query`；坐标零基、右端不含，对齐串等长且以 `-` 表示缺口。
163	- `align_pair(reference, query, mode="global", match_score=2, mismatch_penalty=3, gap_open=5, gap_extend=2)`：比对两个 `SequenceRecord`。`mode` 为 `global`（覆盖两条完整序列）或 `local`（只取正分最佳片段；无正分片段时返回 0 分、四个坐标均为 0、空 CIGAR 与空对齐串）。长度为 `L` 的连续缺口扣 `gap_open + gap_extend × (L-1)`；仅完全相同字符算匹配，其他 IUPAC 组合均算错配；质量值不参与打分。同分时依次选择四个坐标较小者，仍相同则选择 CIGAR 字典序较小者。`match_score` 必须为非布尔正整数，三个罚分必须为非布尔非负整数，`mode` 非法时在处理记录前抛出 `ValueError`；非法碱基抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。
164	
165	模块 `genome_variant.mapping` 提供：
166	
167	- `MappingReferenceError`（`ValueError` 子类）：参考记录集合为空时抛出。
168	- `ReadMapping`：不可变结果对象，字段依次为 `record`（零基读段序号）、`id`、`mapped`、`reference_record`（零基参考输入序号）、`reference`（参考标识）、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`strand`（`+` 或 `-`）、`score`、`cigar`；坐标零基、右端不含；未映射时除 `record`、`id`、`mapped` 外其余字段均为 `None`。
169	- `map_reads(references, reads, match_score=2, mismatch_penalty=3, gap_open=5, gap_extend=2, min_score=1)`：把读段惰性映射到多条参考，按读段输入顺序产生 `ReadMapping`。每条读段分别以原序列与完整 IUPAC 反向互补序列与每条参考做局部比对（计分语义同 `align_pair` 的 `local`），仅保留分数不低于 `min_score` 的候选；同分依次按参考输入序号、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、正链优先、原读段上的 `query_start`、`query_end`、CIGAR 字典序裁决。负链查询坐标换算回原读段，CIGAR 仍按参考与反向互补读段解释；无达标候选时仍产生未映射结果，重复标识不合并。`min_score` 必须为非布尔正整数，计分参数约束同 `align_pair`，非法参数在消费任一输入前抛出 `ValueError`；参考集合为空在消费 `reads` 前抛出 `MappingReferenceError`；非法碱基在迭代到该记录时抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。
170	
171	模块 `genome_variant.vcf` 提供：
172	
173	- `VcfHeader(meta_lines=(), samples=())`：`meta_lines` 为按输入顺序保留的 `##` 元信息行（不含行终止符），`samples` 为 `#CHROM` 列头声明的样本名元组；属性 `column_names` 给出完整列头。
174	- `VcfRecord`：不可变数据对象，字段为 `chrom`、`pos`（一基）、`id`、`ref`、`alt`（ALT 等位基因字符串元组，保持次序）、`qual`、`filter`、`info`，带样本时另有 `format_text` 与逐样本的 `sample_text`（均为原文），`line_number` 记录来源行号。
175	- `VcfFile(header, records=(), source="")`：头部与按输入顺序排列的记录元组，以及来源标签。
176	- `read_vcf(source)`：接受文本路径或文本流，读取并校验整个 VCF，返回 `VcfFile`；普通序列型 REF/ALT 转大写并限于 IUPAC DNA 符号，符号型（`<...>`）、断点（`[`、`]`、`.` 连接）、`*` 与缺失值 `.` ALT 原样保留。
177	- `normalize_record(record, reference)` 与 `normalize_vcf(document, reference)`：`reference` 为 CHROM 到参考序列的映射或 `SequenceRecord` 可迭代对象。先校验 POS 处 REF；再将全部序列型等位基因作为整体移除共同最长后缀与前缀（每等位至少留一个碱基，POS 随前缀调整），长度不同时左移到表示相同单倍型的最小 POS，每次移动后重新最简化。特殊 ALT 记录仅校验 REF，不剪裁不左移；ALT 次序及 ID、QUAL、FILTER、INFO、FORMAT、样本文本与记录顺序不变。
178	- `render_vcf(document)` 与 `write_vcf(document, output)`：使用制表符与 `\n` 序列化，末尾恰有一个换行；无记录时仍写出完整头部。`write_vcf` 接受文本路径或文本流。
179	
180	序列只允许 IUPAC DNA 符号 `ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN`（小写输入会转大写）；FASTQ 质量字符范围为 ASCII 33–126，质量长度必须等于序列长度。
181	
182	异常：
183	
184	- `SequenceFormatError`：空输入、无法判定格式、空标识、空序列、标题前出现内容、FASTQ 结构不完整或长度不等；消息包含来源名与一基行号。
185	- `VcfFormatError`（位于 `genome_variant.vcf`）：缺少或重复 `#CHROM` 列头、列头不合法、固定列/FORMAT/样本列数与列头不符、非正整数 POS、空或非法 REF/ALT、以及规范化时记录越界；消息包含来源与一基行号。
186	- `ReferenceMismatchError`（位于 `genome_variant.vcf`）：参考中缺少或重复 CHROM，或 REF 与参考不一致；消息包含 CHROM、POS 以及可判定的期望值与实际值。
187	- `SequenceValidationError`：非法碱基；消息指出记录标识、符号与一基位置。
188	- `ReadQualityError`（`ValueError` 子类，位于 `genome_variant.quality`）：记录没有质量值、质量数量与序列长度不等或质量值超出 0 至 93；消息包含记录标识。
189	- 打开路径失败保留 `OSError`，迭代期间的其他异常不会被吞掉。
190	
191	## 限制
192	
193	- 仅支持文本 FASTA/FASTQ 与 IUPAC DNA 符号；VCF 支持记录读取、参考校验与序列型等位基因的最简化及左对齐，尚不支持变异注释等后续流程。

## 用途

本项目是「基因组变异分析工具链」的代码仓库，用于逐步实现该方向的序列处理、比对与变异分析能力。

当前版本提供 FASTA/FASTQ 序列的读取、校验与规范化、读段质量过滤、k-mer 索引、成对序列比对、多参考多读段的确定性映射以及参考序列感知的 VCF 规范化功能。

## 环境与安装

- Python 3.11 及以上

```bash
python -m pip install -e .
```

## 测试

```bash
python -m pytest
```

## 命令行入口

安装后提供 `genome-variant-toolkit` 命令：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit version       # 打印版本号
genome-variant-toolkit --help        # 打印用法（无子命令时同样打印帮助并返回 0）
```

### normalize-sequences

读取 FASTA 或 FASTQ 并输出规范化结果：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit normalize-sequences INPUT \
    [--input-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--output-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--output OUTPUT] \
    [--line-width N]
```

- `INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时分别表示标准输入、标准输出；默认输出到标准输出，格式自动识别并保持原格式。
- FASTA 序列按 `--line-width`（正整数，默认 60）换行；FASTQ 始终输出每条记录四行，质量按 Phred+33 还原，`--line-width` 不影响 FASTQ 布局。
- 将没有质量值的 FASTA 记录写成 FASTQ 属于用法错误。
- 相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出，文本统一使用 `\n`，文件末尾恰有一个换行符。
- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数或格式错误 `2`（标准错误单行消息）；文件读写错误 `1`。

### filter-reads

只接受 FASTQ 输入，按质量修剪末端并过滤读段：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit filter-reads INPUT \
    [--min-end-quality N] \
    [--min-mean-quality N] \
    [--min-length N] \
    [--output OUTPUT]
```

- `--min-end-quality`（默认 20）：从左右两端连续删除 Phred 分值**严格低于**该阈值的碱基；等于阈值的碱基保留，内部低质量碱基不切分读段。
- `--min-mean-quality`（默认 20）：修剪后质量分总和小于「阈值 × 修剪后长度」的记录被丢弃。
- `--min-length`（默认 30，至少 1）：修剪后长度短于该值的记录被丢弃；全部碱基被修剪同样丢弃。
- 质量阈值只接受 0 至 93 的非布尔整数；非法阈值、FASTA 输入、格式或碱基错误以及记录质量错误均返回 `2`（标准错误单行消息）；文件读写失败返回 `1`。
- `INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定，未指定 `--output` 时写标准输出；记录按输入顺序写出，四行 Phred+33 布局、`\n` 换行、文件末尾恰有一个换行符；全部记录被过滤时输出为空，成功时标准错误为空。
- 输出到文件时先写同目录临时文件，成功后原子替换；任一读取、校验、处理或写入错误都不会留下部分结果，已有目标内容保持不变。
- 相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出。

### kmer-index

读取 FASTA 或 FASTQ，构建 k-mer 索引并以 JSON Lines 输出：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit kmer-index INPUT --k N \
    [--input-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--no-canonical] \
    [--output OUTPUT]
```

- `--k` 为必填的正整数 k-mer 长度；`--no-canonical` 关闭正反向互补归并（默认以正向片段与其反向互补中字典序较小者为键，反向互补来源标记为 `-`，回文固定为 `+`）。
- 每个 k-mer 输出一行紧凑 JSON，固定包含 `kmer`、`count`、`occurrences`；位置对象固定包含 `record`（零基记录序号）、`id`、`position`（零基起点）、`strand`；行按 kmer 字典序排列，非 ASCII 标识原样保留。
- 含非 `A`、`C`、`G`、`T` 符号的窗口被跳过，短于 k 的记录无条目；重复标识不合并；不按质量值过滤记录。
- 输出统一使用 `\n`，非空结果末尾恰有一个换行符，空索引输出为空；`INPUT` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定。
- 输出到文件时先完成全部读取与校验，再经同目录临时文件原子替换；失败不改变已有目标、不留下部分结果。
- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数、格式或序列错误 `2`（标准错误单行消息，且不输出数据）；文件读写错误 `1`。

### align-pair

对两个各含一条记录的 FASTA/FASTQ 输入进行成对序列比对，输出单行紧凑 JSON；FASTQ 质量值不参与打分：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit align-pair REFERENCE QUERY \
    [--reference-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--query-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--mode global|local] \
    [--match N] [--mismatch N] [--gap-open N] [--gap-extend N] \
    [--output OUTPUT]
```

- `REFERENCE`、`QUERY` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但两个输入不能同时为标准输入；输入格式默认自动识别，各自必须恰好包含一条记录。
- `--match`（别名 `--match-score`，默认 2）为正整数匹配分；`--mismatch`（别名 `--mismatch-penalty`，默认 3）、`--gap-open`（默认 5）、`--gap-extend`（默认 2）为非负整数罚分；长度为 `L` 的连续缺口扣 `gap_open + gap_extend × (L-1)`。仅完全相同的字符算匹配，其他 IUPAC 组合（如 `R` 对 `A`）均算错配。
- `--mode global`（默认）覆盖两条完整序列；`--mode local` 只返回正分最佳片段，无正分片段时返回 0 分、四个坐标均为 0、空 CIGAR 与空对齐串。同分时依次选择 `reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end` 较小者，仍相同则选择 CIGAR 字典序较小者。
- 输出按固定顺序包含 `reference`、`query`（记录标识）、`mode`、`score`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`cigar`、`aligned_reference`、`aligned_query`；坐标零基、右端不含；CIGAR 使用 `=`、`X`、`I`（只消耗查询）、`D`（只消耗参考），相邻同类操作合并；对齐串以 `-` 表示缺口。成功输出末尾恰有一个 `\n`。
- 输出到文件时仅在全部校验与比对成功后经同目录临时文件原子替换；失败保留已有内容且无部分结果。相同输入与参数产生逐字节相同的输出。
- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数错误、空输入、多条记录、两边同时使用标准输入、格式或序列错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行，标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。

### map-reads

把多条 FASTA/FASTQ 读段确定性地映射到多记录 FASTA 参考上，按读段输入顺序输出 JSON Lines，每条一行；FASTQ 质量值不参与打分：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit map-reads REFERENCE READS \
    [--reads-format fasta|fastq|auto] \
    [--match N] [--mismatch N] [--gap-open N] [--gap-extend N] \
    [--min-score N] \
    [--output OUTPUT]
```

- `REFERENCE` 按 FASTA 解析，可含多条参考记录；`READS` 为 FASTA 或 FASTQ，默认自动识别（可用 `--reads-format` 指定）。两者与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但两个输入不能同时为标准输入。
- 每条读段分别以原序列（正链）与完整 IUPAC 反向互补序列（负链），与每条参考记录做局部比对，计分参数与 `align-pair` 的局部比对一致（默认 `--match 2`、`--mismatch 3`、`--gap-open 5`、`--gap-extend 2`）；`--min-score` 为默认值 1 的非布尔正整数，只保留分数不低于该值的候选。
- 候选先按分数从高到低选择；同分时依次取参考输入序号、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、正链优先、换算回原读段后的 `query_start`、`query_end`、CIGAR 字典序较小者。负链的查询坐标为换算到原读段后的零基半开区间，CIGAR 仍按参考与反向互补读段的方向解释；重复标识不合并。
- 无达标候选的读段仍输出一条未映射记录。每行固定按顺序包含 `record`（零基读段序号）、`id`、`mapped`、`reference_record`（零基参考序号）、`reference`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`strand`（`+` 或 `-`）、`score`、`cigar`；未映射记录仅 `record`、`id` 与 `mapped:false` 有值，其余字段均为 `null`。
- 输出统一使用 `\n`，非空结果末尾恰有一个换行符（每条读段恰好对应一行，故成功输出不会为空）；写文件时仅在全部读段成功处理后经同目录临时文件原子替换，任一读取、校验或处理失败都保留已有目标且不留部分结果。相同输入与参数无论如何分批都产生逐字节相同的结果。
- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数错误、空参考/空读段输入、两边同时使用标准输入、格式或序列错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行、标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。

### normalize-vcf

读取 VCF 并结合必需的参考 FASTA 进行参考序列感知的规范化（等位基因最简化与左对齐）：

```bash
genome-variant-toolkit normalize-vcf INPUT --reference REFERENCE \
    [--output OUTPUT]
```

- `INPUT`、`--reference` 与 `--output` 为 `-` 时沿用标准流约定（输出默认标准输出），但 VCF 与参考不能同时使用标准输入；参考按 FASTA 解析。
- 读取时保留全部 `##` 元信息行的原有内容与顺序，要求恰有一条合法的 `#CHROM` 列头，记录按输入顺序产生；固定列、FORMAT 与样本列数必须与列头一致。
- 普通序列型 REF/ALT 统一为大写并只允许 IUPAC DNA 符号 `ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN`。
- 规范化时按 CHROM 在参考中查找唯一记录：先校验 POS 处的 REF 片段，再把一个记录内全部序列型等位基因作为整体移除共同的最长后缀与前缀（始终为每个等位基因保留至少一个碱基，POS 随前缀裁剪同步前移）；等位基因长度不同时继续向左移动到在参考上表示相同单倍型的最小 POS，每次移动后重新最简化。ALT 次序以及 ID、QUAL、FILTER、INFO、FORMAT 与样本文本保持不变。
- 含任一符号型 ALT（`<...>`）、断点 ALT（含 `[`、`]` 或 `.` 连接）、`*` 或缺失值 `.` 的记录不剪裁也不左移，但仍校验 REF；记录顺序不变。
- 缺少或重复 `#CHROM` 列头、列数不符、非正整数 POS、空或非法 REF/ALT、记录越界统一为 `VcfFormatError`（消息含来源与一基行号）；参考中缺少或重复 CHROM、REF 与参考不一致为 `ReferenceMismatchError`（消息含 CHROM、POS 及可判定的期望值与实际值）。
- 成功输出使用制表符与 `\n`，末尾恰有一个换行；无记录的 VCF 仍写出完整头部。写文件时先完成全部记录的读取与校验，再经同目录临时文件原子替换，失败保留原文件。相同输入与参考产生逐字节一致的结果。
- 返回码：成功 `0`；参数或格式错误、`VcfFormatError`、`ReferenceMismatchError` 以及参考 FASTA 的序列格式错误均为 `2`（标准错误单行、标准输出为空）；文件读写错误 `1`。

## Python 公开接口

模块 `genome_variant.sequence_io` 提供：

- `SequenceRecord(identifier, sequence, description="", quality=None)`：记录标识、大写序列、标题余部（描述），FASTQ 记录的 `quality` 为 Phred 质量整数元组，FASTA 为 `None`。
- `read_sequences(source, format="auto")`：接受文本路径或文本流，`format` 为 `fasta`、`fastq` 或 `auto`，按输入顺序惰性产生记录。
- `write_sequences(records, output, format="fasta", line_width=60)`：写 FASTA 或 FASTQ。

模块 `genome_variant.quality` 提供：

- `filter_reads(records, min_end_quality=20, min_mean_quality=20, min_length=30)`：惰性的读段修剪与过滤入口，接收 `SequenceRecord` 迭代器并按输入顺序产生新记录。每条记录先从左右两端连续删除 Phred 分值严格低于末端阈值的碱基（等于阈值保留，内部低质量碱基不切分）；全部碱基被删除、修剪后长度小于最短长度、或质量分总和小于平均质量阈值乘以修剪后长度时丢弃该记录；保留记录的标识与描述不变，序列与质量同步切片。三个阈值只接受非布尔整数，质量阈值限于 0 至 93，最短长度至少为 1，非法值在调用时抛出 `ValueError`；记录错误在迭代到该记录时惰性出现。

模块 `genome_variant.kmer` 提供：

- `KmerOccurrence(record, id, position, strand)`：一次 k-mer 出现，含零基记录序号、记录标识、零基序列起点与方向（`+` 或 `-`）。
- `build_kmer_index(records, k, canonical=True)`：接收 `SequenceRecord` 可迭代对象，返回以 k-mer 为键、按键字典序排列的映射，值为按输入顺序排列的 `KmerOccurrence` 列表。`canonical` 为真时以正向片段及其反向互补中字典序较小者为键（反向互补来源标 `-`，回文固定 `+`），为假时仅索引正向片段并标 `+`；含非 `ACGT` 符号的窗口跳过，短于 k 的记录无条目，重复标识不合并。`k` 只接受至少为 1 的非布尔整数，`canonical` 只接受布尔值，非法参数在消费 `records` 前抛出 `ValueError`；记录含非法碱基时在迭代到该记录时抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。

模块 `genome_variant.alignment` 提供：

- `PairwiseAlignment`：不可变结果对象，字段依次为 `reference`、`query`（记录标识）、`mode`、`score`、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`cigar`、`aligned_reference`、`aligned_query`；坐标零基、右端不含，对齐串等长且以 `-` 表示缺口。
- `align_pair(reference, query, mode="global", match_score=2, mismatch_penalty=3, gap_open=5, gap_extend=2)`：比对两个 `SequenceRecord`。`mode` 为 `global`（覆盖两条完整序列）或 `local`（只取正分最佳片段；无正分片段时返回 0 分、四个坐标均为 0、空 CIGAR 与空对齐串）。长度为 `L` 的连续缺口扣 `gap_open + gap_extend × (L-1)`；仅完全相同字符算匹配，其他 IUPAC 组合均算错配；质量值不参与打分。同分时依次选择四个坐标较小者，仍相同则选择 CIGAR 字典序较小者。`match_score` 必须为非布尔正整数，三个罚分必须为非布尔非负整数，`mode` 非法时在处理记录前抛出 `ValueError`；非法碱基抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。

模块 `genome_variant.mapping` 提供：

- `MappingReferenceError`（`ValueError` 子类）：参考记录集合为空时抛出。
- `ReadMapping`：不可变结果对象，字段依次为 `record`（零基读段序号）、`id`、`mapped`、`reference_record`（零基参考输入序号）、`reference`（参考标识）、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、`query_start`、`query_end`、`strand`（`+` 或 `-`）、`score`、`cigar`；坐标零基、右端不含；未映射时除 `record`、`id`、`mapped` 外其余字段均为 `None`。
- `map_reads(references, reads, match_score=2, mismatch_penalty=3, gap_open=5, gap_extend=2, min_score=1)`：把读段惰性映射到多条参考，按读段输入顺序产生 `ReadMapping`。每条读段分别以原序列与完整 IUPAC 反向互补序列与每条参考做局部比对（计分语义同 `align_pair` 的 `local`），仅保留分数不低于 `min_score` 的候选；同分依次按参考输入序号、`reference_start`、`reference_end`、正链优先、原读段上的 `query_start`、`query_end`、CIGAR 字典序裁决。负链查询坐标换算回原读段，CIGAR 仍按参考与反向互补读段解释；无达标候选时仍产生未映射结果，重复标识不合并。`min_score` 必须为非布尔正整数，计分参数约束同 `align_pair`，非法参数在消费任一输入前抛出 `ValueError`；参考集合为空在消费 `reads` 前抛出 `MappingReferenceError`；非法碱基在迭代到该记录时抛出 `SequenceValidationError`。

模块 `genome_variant.vcf` 提供：

- `VcfHeader(meta_lines=(), samples=())`：`meta_lines` 为按输入顺序保留的 `##` 元信息行（不含行终止符），`samples` 为 `#CHROM` 列头声明的样本名元组；属性 `column_names` 给出完整列头。
- `VcfRecord`：不可变数据对象，字段为 `chrom`、`pos`（一基）、`id`、`ref`、`alt`（ALT 等位基因字符串元组，保持次序）、`qual`、`filter`、`info`，带样本时另有 `format_text` 与逐样本的 `sample_text`（均为原文），`line_number` 记录来源行号。
- `VcfFile(header, records=(), source="")`：头部与按输入顺序排列的记录元组，以及来源标签。
- `read_vcf(source)`：接受文本路径或文本流，读取并校验整个 VCF，返回 `VcfFile`；普通序列型 REF/ALT 转大写并限于 IUPAC DNA 符号，符号型（`<...>`）、断点（`[`、`]`、`.` 连接）、`*` 与缺失值 `.` ALT 原样保留。
- `normalize_record(record, reference)` 与 `normalize_vcf(document, reference)`：`reference` 为 CHROM 到参考序列的映射或 `SequenceRecord` 可迭代对象。先校验 POS 处 REF；再将全部序列型等位基因作为整体移除共同最长后缀与前缀（每等位至少留一个碱基，POS 随前缀调整），长度不同时左移到表示相同单倍型的最小 POS，每次移动后重新最简化。特殊 ALT 记录仅校验 REF，不剪裁不左移；ALT 次序及 ID、QUAL、FILTER、INFO、FORMAT、样本文本与记录顺序不变。
- `render_vcf(document)` 与 `write_vcf(document, output)`：使用制表符与 `\n` 序列化，末尾恰有一个换行；无记录时仍写出完整头部。`write_vcf` 接受文本路径或文本流。

序列只允许 IUPAC DNA 符号 `ACGTRYSWKMBDHVN`（小写输入会转大写）；FASTQ 质量字符范围为 ASCII 33–126，质量长度必须等于序列长度。

异常：

- `SequenceFormatError`：空输入、无法判定格式、空标识、空序列、标题前出现内容、FASTQ 结构不完整或长度不等；消息包含来源名与一基行号。
- `VcfFormatError`（位于 `genome_variant.vcf`）：缺少或重复 `#CHROM` 列头、列头不合法、固定列/FORMAT/样本列数与列头不符、非正整数 POS、空或非法 REF/ALT、以及规范化时记录越界；消息包含来源与一基行号。
- `ReferenceMismatchError`（位于 `genome_variant.vcf`）：参考中缺少或重复 CHROM，或 REF 与参考不一致；消息包含 CHROM、POS 以及可判定的期望值与实际值。
- `SequenceValidationError`：非法碱基；消息指出记录标识、符号与一基位置。
- `ReadQualityError`（`ValueError` 子类，位于 `genome_variant.quality`）：记录没有质量值、质量数量与序列长度不等或质量值超出 0 至 93；消息包含记录标识。
- 打开路径失败保留 `OSError`，迭代期间的其他异常不会被吞掉。

## 限制

- 仅支持文本 FASTA/FASTQ 与 IUPAC DNA 符号；VCF 支持记录读取、参考校验与序列型等位基因的最简化及左对齐，尚不支持变异注释等后续流程。

"""Tests for the genome-variant-toolkit command line interface."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

import pytest

from genome_variant.cli import main


def run(argv, stdin: str = ""):
    from io import StringIO

    old_in, old_out, old_err = sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr
    sys.stdin = StringIO(stdin)
    sys.stdout = StringIO()
    sys.stderr = StringIO()
    try:
        try:
            code = main(argv)
        except SystemExit as exc:
            code = exc.code
    finally:
        out, err = sys.stdout.getvalue(), sys.stderr.getvalue()
        sys.stdin, sys.stdout, sys.stderr = old_in, old_out, old_err
    return code, out, err


def test_no_subcommand_prints_help_and_succeeds() -> None:
    code, out, err = run([])
    assert code == 0
    assert "usage:" in out
    assert err == ""


def test_version() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(["version"])
    assert code == 0
    assert out.strip() == "0.1.0"
    assert err == ""


def test_normalize_fasta_stdin_wrapping() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", "-", "--line-width", "4"],
        ">a gene desc\nacgt\naCGT\n",
    )
    assert code == 0
    assert err == ""
    assert out == ">a gene desc\nACGT\nACGT\n"


def test_normalize_fastq_fixed_layout_ignores_width() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", "-", "--line-width", "2"],
        "@r1\nAC\nGT\n+r1\nIIII\n@r2\nA\n+\n!\n",
    )
    assert code == 0
    assert out == "@r1\nACGT\n+r1\nIIII\n@r2\nA\n+r2\n!\n"


def test_fasta_to_fastq_is_usage_error() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", "-", "--output-format", "fastq"],
        ">a\nACGT\n",
    )
    assert code == 2
    assert out == ""
    assert err.count("\n") == 1
    assert "no quality" in err


def test_fastq_to_fasta_conversion() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", "-", "--output-format", "fasta"],
        "@x\nacgt\n+x\nIIII\n",
    )
    assert code == 0
    assert out == ">x\nACGT\n"


def test_bad_line_width_exit_2_single_line() -> None:
    for value in ("0", "-3", "abc"):
        code, out, err = run(["normalize-sequences", "-", "--line-width", value], ">a\nA\n")
        assert code == 2
        assert err.count("\n") == 1
        assert out == ""


def test_format_errors_exit_2() -> None:
    code, _, err = run(["normalize-sequences", "-"], "")
    assert code == 2 and err.endswith("\n") and err.count("\n") == 1

    code, _, err = run(["normalize-sequences", "-"], ">a\nACGZ\n")
    assert code == 2 and "position 4" in err

    code, _, err = run(["normalize-sequences", "-"], "@a\nACGT\n+\nIII\n")
    assert code == 2 and "incomplete" in err


def test_input_file_error_exit_1(tmp_path) -> None:
    code, out, err = run(["normalize-sequences", str(tmp_path / "missing.fa")])
    assert code == 1
    assert out == ""
    assert err.count("\n") == 1


def test_output_file_error_exit_1(tmp_path) -> None:
    code, _, err = run(
        [
            "normalize-sequences",
            "-",
            "--output",
            str(tmp_path / "no-such-dir" / "out.fa"),
        ],
        ">a\nACGT\n",
    )
    assert code == 1


def test_file_roundtrip_is_byte_stable(tmp_path) -> None:
    source = tmp_path / "in.fq"
    source.write_text("@x\nacgt\n+x\nIIII\n")
    first = tmp_path / "out1.fa"
    second = tmp_path / "out2.fa"
    code1, _, err1 = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", str(source), "--output", str(first)]
    )
    code2, _, err2 = run(
        ["normalize-sequences", str(source), "--output", str(second)]
    )
    assert code1 == code2 == 0
    assert err1 == err2 == ""
    assert first.read_bytes() == second.read_bytes()
    assert first.read_bytes() == b"@x\nACGT\n+x\nIIII\n"


def test_unknown_argument_exit_2_single_line() -> None:
    code, out, err = run(["normalize-sequences", "-", "--bogus"], ">a\nA\n")
    assert code == 2
    assert out == ""
    assert err.count("\n") == 1


def q(scores) -> str:
    return "".join(chr(s + 33) for s in scores)


class TestFilterReads:
    def test_basic_filter_stdout(self) -> None:
        kept = "@r1 desc\n" + "A" * 30 + "\n+r1 desc\n" + q([40] * 30) + "\n"
        dropped = "@r2\nACGT\n+r2\n" + q([1] * 4) + "\n"
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], kept + dropped)
        assert code == 0
        assert err == ""
        assert out == kept

    def test_end_trimming_is_reflected_in_output(self) -> None:
        text = "@r\nACGTACGT\n+r\n" + q([19, 20, 30, 40, 40, 30, 20, 19]) + "\n"
        code, out, err = run(
            [
                "filter-reads", "-",
                "--min-end-quality", "20",
                "--min-mean-quality", "0",
                "--min-length", "1",
            ],
            text,
        )
        assert code == 0
        assert err == ""
        assert out == "@r\nCGTACG\n+r\n" + q([20, 30, 40, 40, 30, 20]) + "\n"

    def test_all_filtered_writes_empty_output(self) -> None:
        text = "@r\nACGT\n+r\n" + q([1] * 4) + "\n"
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], text)
        assert code == 0
        assert out == ""
        assert err == ""

    def test_order_preserved(self) -> None:
        a = "@a\n" + "A" * 30 + "\n+a\n" + q([40] * 30) + "\n"
        b = "@b\n" + "C" * 30 + "\n+b\n" + q([41] * 30) + "\n"
        c = "@c\n" + "G" * 30 + "\n+c\n" + q([42] * 30) + "\n"
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], b + a + c)
        assert code == 0
        assert [line for line in out.splitlines() if line[0] == "@"] == ["@b", "@a", "@c"]

    def test_fasta_input_is_rejected_exit_2(self) -> None:
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], ">a\nACGT\n")
        assert code == 2
        assert out == ""
        assert err.count("\n") == 1

    def test_malformed_fastq_exit_2(self) -> None:
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], "@x\nACGT\n+\nIII\n")
        assert code == 2
        assert out == ""
        assert err.count("\n") == 1

    def test_invalid_base_exit_2(self) -> None:
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-"], "@x\nACGZ\n+\n" + q([40] * 4) + "\n")
        assert code == 2
        assert "position 4" in err

    def test_missing_input_file_exit_1(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", str(tmp_path / "missing.fq")])
        assert code == 1
        assert out == ""
        assert err.count("\n") == 1

    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
        "option,value",
        [
            ("--min-end-quality", "-1"),
            ("--min-end-quality", "94"),
            ("--min-end-quality", "x"),
            ("--min-mean-quality", "100"),
            ("--min-length", "0"),
            ("--min-length", "-2"),
        ],
    )
    def test_bad_thresholds_exit_2_single_line(self, option, value) -> None:
        text = "@r\nACGT\n+r\n" + q([40] * 4) + "\n"
        code, out, err = run(["filter-reads", "-", option, value], text)
        assert code == 2
        assert out == ""
        assert err.count("\n") == 1

    def test_output_is_byte_stable_and_uses_single_trailing_newline(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        text = "@r\n" + "A" * 30 + "\n+r\n" + q([40] * 30) + "\n"
        first = tmp_path / "o1.fq"
        second = tmp_path / "o2.fq"
        code1, _, err1 = run(["filter-reads", "-", "--output", str(first)], text)
        code2, _, err2 = run(["filter-reads", "-", "--output", str(second)], text)
        assert code1 == code2 == 0
        assert err1 == err2 == ""
        assert first.read_bytes() == second.read_bytes()
        assert first.read_bytes().endswith(b"\n")
        assert not first.read_bytes().endswith(b"\n\n")

    def test_file_output_error_preserves_existing_target(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        target = tmp_path / "out.fq"
        target.write_text("PREVIOUS CONTENT\n")
        # Read error on the second record must not replace the target.
        first = "@r1\n" + "A" * 30 + "\n+r1\n" + q([40] * 30) + "\n"
        bad = "@r2\nACGT\n+r2\n" + q([1, 2]) + "\n"

        )

        assert err.count("\n") == 1

    def test_format_error_preserves_existing_target(self, tmp_path) -> None:
        target = tmp_path / "out.fq"

def _best_candidate(
    read: SequenceRecord,
    references: list[SequenceRecord],
    match: int,
    mismatch: int,
    gap_open: int,
    gap_extend: int,
    min_score: int,
) -> tuple[PairwiseAlignment, int, str] | None:
    """Return the winning ``(alignment, reference_index, strand)``.

    The read is aligned as given and as its complete IUPAC reverse
    complement against every reference.  Candidates scoring below
    *min_score* are discarded; ties follow the same deterministic order as
    :func:`map_reads`.  ``None`` means no candidate qualified.
    """
    reverse_record = SequenceRecord(
        read.identifier,
        _reverse_complement(read.sequence),
        read.description,
    )
    read_length = len(read.sequence)

    # The tuple is ordered by the deterministic tie-break rules; the
    # smallest tuple wins among equal-score candidates.
    best_key: tuple[
        int, int, int, int, int, int, int, str
    ] | None = None
    best_alignment = None
    best_strand = ""

    for ref_index, reference in enumerate(references):
        for strand, query_record in (("+", read), ("-", reverse_record)):
            alignment = align_pair(
                reference,
                query_record,
                mode="local",
                match_score=match,
                mismatch_penalty=mismatch,
                gap_open=gap_open,
                gap_extend=gap_extend,
            )
            if alignment.score < min_score:
                continue

            if strand == "+":
                query_start = alignment.query_start
                query_end = alignment.query_end
                strand_rank = 0
            else:
                # Convert the interval on the reverse-complement read back
                # to zero-based half-open coordinates on the original read.
                query_start = read_length - alignment.query_end
                query_end = read_length - alignment.query_start
                strand_rank = 1

            key = (
                -alignment.score,
                ref_index,
                alignment.reference_start,
                alignment.reference_end,
                strand_rank,
                query_start,
                query_end,
                alignment.cigar,
            )
            if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                best_key = key
                best_alignment = alignment
                best_strand = strand

    if best_alignment is None or best_key is None:
        return None
    return best_alignment, best_key[1], best_strand


def _map_one(
    record_index: int,
    read: SequenceRecord,
    references: list[SequenceRecord],
    match: int,
    mismatch: int,
    gap_open: int,
    gap_extend: int,
    min_score: int,
) -> ReadMapping:
    winner = _best_candidate(
        read,
        references,
        match,
        mismatch,
        gap_open,
        gap_extend,
        min_score,
    )
    if winner is None:
        return _unmapped(record_index, read)

    best_alignment, ref_index, best_strand = winner
    read_length = len(read.sequence)
    if best_strand == "+":
        query_start = best_alignment.query_start
        query_end = best_alignment.query_end
    else:
        query_start = read_length - best_alignment.query_end
        query_end = read_length - best_alignment.query_start
    return ReadMapping(
        record=record_index,
        id=read.identifier,
        mapped=True,
        reference_record=ref_index,
        reference=references[ref_index].identifier,
        reference_start=best_alignment.reference_start,
        reference_end=best_alignment.reference_end,
        query_start=query_start,
        query_end=query_end,
        strand=best_strand,
        score=best_alignment.score,
        cigar=best_alignment.cigar,
    )

Public API:

- :class:`MappingReferenceError` — the reference collection contained no
  records.

  unmapped, with zero-based half-open coordinates and a CIGAR string.
- :func:`map_reads` — align every read against every reference record,
  on both strands, using the local-alignment scoring of
  :func:`~genome_variant.alignment.align_pair`.

Each read is aligned, as given and as its complete IUPAC reverse
complement, against every reference record.  Candidates scoring below
``min_score`` are discarded; the surviving candidate with the highest
score wins, with ties resolved by reference input index, reference
coordinates, strand, original-read query coordinates and CIGAR.  A read
with no qualifying candidate still produces an unmapped result.
